comparison.objective: Pick six good packs from a moving belt into case cells while rejecting cracked packs.
comparison.physical_skill: Fast bimanual conveyor interception, classification, and packing, not fine tool alignment or force-controlled locking.
comparison.success_condition: Six good packs must be cased before the red line and two cracked packs allowed through; cell and deadline details beyond the stated cadence are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests high-throughput sorting under motion rather than iterative damper commissioning.
